BUYING GUIDE

What Matters in a Gaming Mini PC

Start with the games you play and the monitor you already own.

Start with the GPU

Integrated graphics can handle esports, indie, and older games with tuned settings. A dedicated GPU gives you more headroom in demanding titles.

Match your display

Check benchmarks for your games at your monitor’s resolution and refresh rate. Verify the PC’s ports support the display mode you want.

Check the configuration

Look for a preconfigured model with RAM and an SSD. Choose enough storage for your library, and leave room for airflow and the power adapter.
